description: Search flights on Kiwi.com by route and date or date range, build multi-city trips, chart daily fares, fetch popular routes from a city, or look up airports/cities/stations. No account, API key or proxy setup is needed.

airlines.description: Only keep itineraries that include at least one of these 2-letter IATA airline codes, e.g. `U2`, `FR`, `BA`.
airlines.title: Include airlines

containsKeyword.description: Only keep flights whose airline, flight number, airport or city contains this text (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Contains keyword

destination.description: Airport code, city name, or Kiwi place ID (search, priceCalendar). Use `anywhere` to search every destination.
destination.title: Destination

excludeAirlines.description: Drop itineraries that include any of these 2-letter IATA airline codes.
excludeAirlines.title: Exclude airlines

legs.description: For mode=multiCity: 2–8 objects like `{"origin":"london","destination":"paris","date":"2026-12-15"}`. Each leg is a separate flight.
legs.title: Multi-city legs

maxDurationMinutes.description: Drop itineraries longer than this door-to-door duration. Kiwi's server ignores the duration filter, so this is applied to the returned rows.
maxDurationMinutes.title: Maximum duration (minutes)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (1–1000). Kiwi serves one page per search: up to 500 one-way/return rows and up to 1000 multi-city rows. The live total can be lower; no cursor exists.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Drop itineraries priced above this amount (selected currency).
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

minPrice.description: Keep itineraries priced at or above this amount (selected currency).
minPrice.title: Minimum price

enumTitles: Look up airports, cities and stations
mode.title: Mode

origin.description: Airport code, city name, or Kiwi place ID. Examples: `LTN`, `london`, `City:london_gb` (search, priceCalendar, popularRoutes, multiCity fallback).
origin.title: Origin

returnDate.description: Return date (YYYY-MM-DD) for round-trip search and priceCalendar. For priceCalendar it sets the trip length.
returnDate.title: Return date

returnDateEnd.description: Optional last date of a return range (YYYY-MM-DD) for round-trip search.
returnDateEnd.title: Return date range end

sortBy.description: How Kiwi.com sorts the returned itineraries.
sortBy.title: Sort order

stationQuery.description: Free-text term to search airports, cities, countries and points of interest (mode=stationLookup).
stationQuery.title: Station lookup query

stops.description: Filter by the number of stops on the outbound journey.
stops.title: Max stops

travelDate.description: Outbound departure date (YYYY-MM-DD) for search, priceCalendar and popularRoutes. When omitted, the actor uses today + 30 days.
travelDate.title: Departure date

travelDateEnd.description: Optional last date of a departure range (YYYY-MM-DD). Search requests the whole range in one call; priceCalendar returns one row per day.
travelDateEnd.title: Departure date range end

tripType.description: Auto (default) is one-way unless returnDate is set, then round-trip. Choose oneWay or roundTrip to force it.
tripType.title: Trip type

title: Kiwi.com Flight Fares & Popular Routes Scraper Input
